-- Sélection des articles par utilisateur (issue #20)
-- user_id optionnel : NULL = tous les abonnés actifs
SELECT u.id AS user_id,
       u.email,
       u.pseudo,
       u.interests,
       u.send_time,
       u.timezone,
       COALESCE(
         json_agg(
           json_build_object(
             'id', a.id, 'title', a.title, 'url', a.url, 'summary', a.summary,
             'source', a.source, 'tags', a.tags, 'published_at', a.published_at,
             'score', a.score)
           ORDER BY a.score DESC, a.published_at DESC NULLS LAST
         ) FILTER (WHERE a.id IS NOT NULL),
         '[]'::json
       ) AS articles,
       count(a.id) AS nb_articles
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ar.*,
         cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT unnest(ar.tags) INTERSECT SELECT unnest(u.interests))) AS score
  FROM articles ar
  WHERE ar.tags && u.interests                       -- seulement ses intérêts
    AND NOT EXISTS (                                 -- jamais deux fois le même article
      SELECT 1 FROM sent_articles s
      WHERE s.user_id = u.id AND s.article_id = ar.id)
  ORDER BY score DESC, ar.published_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 5                                            -- 5 plus pertinents puis plus récents
) a ON true
WHERE u.status = 'active'                            -- ignorer les désabonnés
  AND cardinality(u.interests) > 0
  AND ($1::int IS NULL OR u.id = $1::int)
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY u.id;
